Body surface area by the Haycock formula

Source: R/phn_zscore.R
bsa_haycock.Rd

Computes body surface area (BSA) from height and weight with the formula of Haycock, Schwartz and Wisotsky (1978): BSA (m^2) = 0.024265 * weight(kg)^0.5378 * height(cm)^0.3964. This is the formula the Pediatric Heart Network used for its echocardiographic z-scores, so it is the one phn_zscore() uses.

Give the height and weight measured at the echocardiogram, not at birth.

Usage

bsa_haycock(height_cm, weight_kg)

Arguments

height_cm

Numeric vector of heights (lengths, for infants) in cm.

weight_kg

Numeric vector of weights in kg, the same length as height_cm or length 1.

Value

A numeric vector of BSA in m^2, NA where either input is NA.

References

Haycock GB, Schwartz GJ, Wisotsky DH. Geometric method for measuring body surface area: a height-weight formula validated in infants, children, and adults. J Pediatr. 1978;93(1):62-66. doi:10.1016/s0022-3476(78)80601-5

See also

phn_zscore()

Examples

bsa_haycock(height_cm = 50, weight_kg = 3.5)
#> [1] 0.224415
